channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Developers are proposing a new Walmart Supercenter on Rutland Town’s former Diamond Run Mall site. The over one-hundred-eighty-thousand square-foot store will include expanded grocery and pharmacy services. A December first hearing will review environmental and fiscal impacts before construction begins.

The Adirondack Park Agency approved a larger dock variance in Lake Placid and a timber harvest permit in Arietta. Board members called for stronger ecological protections. The agency seeks to balance development and environmental concerns.

Bromley Mountain and Smugglers’ Notch plan to open Friday if weather allows. Jay Peak opens Friday for passholders and guests, then to the public Saturday. Stratton Mountain and Bolton Valley have delayed their openings, with Bolton now set for December fifth.

Vermont Fish & Wildlife extended the bear hunting season by a month and added a second bear tag despite overwhelming public opposition. Critics say the department ignored community concerns and scientific evidence. Some suggest mandating bear-proof containers to reduce conflicts.
